name: 48732 · Essexville, MI
findings: ZIP 48732 (Essexville) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48732 (Essexville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48732 (Essexville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
